exposure: high-dose intravenous corticosteroid supplementation during labor and delivery
low-dose intravenous corticosteroid supplementation during labor and delivery
cohort: The study included 102 pregnant women who received oral corticosteroid therapy, delivered at Osaka University Hospital, and were administered intravenous corticosteroid supplementation during labor and delivery, split into high-dose (n=47) and low-dose (n=55) groups.
finding: Pregnancy outcomes, including maternal complications and neonatal outcomes, did not significantly differ between women receiving high versus low doses of corticosteroid supplementation during labor and delivery.
